name: dsh-restart-wake
description: Restart DeepSeek Harness safely and wake sessions automatically afterwards. Agent tools for scheduled self-restart, a startup wake registry, and a mutex-guarded restart protocol; the same package also carries self-healing: function probes, asar snapshots, a watchdog that rolls back and restarts, and crash-report re-injection into the affected session. 让 Agent 安全重启 DeepSeek Harness，并在重启后自动唤醒原会话继续工作；同一个包还内置本体自愈——功能探针、asar 快照、看门狗自动回滚重启，以及把故障现场回注原会话。
author: zgq0106 (https://github.com/zgq0106)
